subject: general
question: Which of the following folk dances is performed holding a sword in one hand and a shield in the other?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paika.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paika **is performed holding a sword in one hand and a shield in the other.
 
• Its a martial folk dance where performer is in battle formation with spears and sheild
 
• Paika is a form of long spear and also the word paika signifies battle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santhali dance **is usually performed by each the boys and girls of the Santhal tribe. 

 
 
• It`s terribly almost like the bamboo folks dance of Assam and Mizoram.
 
 
 
• **Jadur **of Bihar is a folk dance particularly popular among the tribal people of South Bihar called the Oraons.
 
• **The Karma dance** form from Mandla district of Madhya Pradesh.
